newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China United in talks to up stake in unit.
newsitem.headline: China United in talks to up stake in unit.

text.p: Gift packaging and property investment concern China United Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was in talks to raise its stake in a 51 percent-owned subsidiary and the purchase might be funded by issue of new shares.

"The negotiation is still in progress and the final terms of the transaction have not been agreed by the parties yet," said the company's managing director Peter Lam. "The transaction may or may not involve the issue of new shares in the company."
The company shares rose HK$0.04 or 9.41 percent to end at HK$0.465 on Thursday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
